home.tagline: Science meets Sanskar: a bridge to a brighter future
home.heroSubtitle: Ayurvedic garbhasanskar guidance and clinical pregnancy physiotherapy for mother and baby in Palanpur.
home.founderRole: Dr. Jagrut Chauhan (BAMS) & Dr. Richa Madhu (PT)
home.problemTitle: Pregnancy without the confusion and isolation
home.problemLead: Expectant parents today face conflicting online advice, routine clinic visits that overlook daily mindset, and physical aches left unaddressed.
home.problemQuote: “Pregnancy is not a medical condition to manage with occasional visits — it is a whole-life journey that thrives on daily care.”

problemPoints.title: Information overload & anxiety
problemPoints.desc: Endless generic online tips cause stress instead of calm, joyful confidence.

problemPoints.title: Overlooked emotional & mental care
problemPoints.desc: Routine checkups track growth markers but rarely guide daily mindset, reading, and meditation.

problemPoints.title: Accepting pain as normal
problemPoints.desc: Pelvic tightness, back pain, and postpartum weakness can be actively relieved and prevented.

problemPoints.title: Fathers left wondering how to help
problemPoints.desc: Partners and family members are often unsure how to support daily pregnancy wellness.

home.definitionBody: Garbha Sanskar means nurturing and guiding the unborn child and parents through positive thoughts, sound, and care.
home.quoteMeaning: Sanskar means the conscious process of nurturing and awakening superior qualities.
home.metaphorTitle: Just like preparing for a healthy harvest
home.metaphorBody: Four essentials create a healthy harvest: pure seed (Beej), fertile soil (Kshetra), nourishing water (Ambu), and the right season (Ritu). In the same way, a healthy baby begins with healthy parents, wholesome food, and a caring daily environment.
home.philosophyBody: Garbha Sanskar is not a single ritual or talisman. It is a healthy daily routine supporting the mother's physical comfort, emotional calm, and nutritional needs.
home.wholeBody: We combine classical Ayurvedic wisdom with evidence-based physiotherapy to support parents with informed choices, gentle movement, and emotional connection.
home.scienceBody: GarbhaSetu combines traditional Garbha Sanskar with modern pregnancy wellness. We focus on parent health, calm routines, and safe physical conditioning.
home.whyNowLead: The 280 days in the womb shape your baby's earliest foundation. What you eat, hear, feel, and practice creates a calm start to life.

whyNowPillars.title: Your baby's brain is forming right now
whyNowPillars.desc: Hearing and brain pathways develop in the womb. Gentle music (Garbha Sangeet), humming, and reading stimulate early growth.

whyNowPillars.title: What you feel, your baby feels
whyNowPillars.desc: Maternal stress hormones reach the baby through the placenta. Daily pranayama (breathwork) and meditation support emotional calm.

whyNowPillars.title: Pelvic strength for smoother labour
whyNowPillars.desc: Pregnancy-safe mobility and pelvic floor exercises ease birth preparation and reduce postpartum weakness.

whyNowPillars.title: Talk, sing, and bond before birth
whyNowPillars.desc: Conscious conversations (Garbha Samvad) and partner touch build a deep, lasting bond with your baby before birth.

aspects.title: Diet & safe movement
aspects.body: Nourishing sattvic meals (Ahara) and gentle pregnancy-safe exercise.

aspects.title: A calm, positive mindset
aspects.body: Lower stress through mindful reading (Swadhyay), music, and quiet reflection.

aspects.title: Parent-child connection
aspects.body: Loving communication (Garbha Samvad) between both parents and baby.

home.equationResult: A healthy start for your baby

services.title: Ayurveda and clinical physiotherapy
services.intro: Ayurvedic garbhasanskar guidance with Dr. Jagrut Chauhan, and pregnancy physiotherapy with Dr. Richa Madhu.
services.ayurvedaIntro: Personalized nutrition, daily routines, swadhyay reading, and calming Garbha Sangeet.
services.counselBody: One-on-one sessions for mindset preparation, emotional wellness, and answering your questions throughout pregnancy.
services.dietBody: Nourishing meals matched to each trimester (Ritucharya), supporting digestion, stamina, and baby development.
mindItems: Month-by-month book reading (Swadhyay) selected for values and positive reflection
Om chanting, mantra resonance, and maternal humming
Pregnancy-safe yoga, pranayama, and stress-relief techniques
Garbha Sangeet — soothing music including Jijabai na halarda and relaxing acoustic melodies
Motivational writing and positive manifestation for your baby
services.samvadBody: Conscious conversations between parents and baby in the womb. Speaking loving words, gentle belly touch, and sharing positive experiences together.
services.activitiesIntro: A creative daily activity sent to your WhatsApp and checked every day.
activities: Mandala art and drawing to build focus and calm
services.journalBody: You receive a structured daily journal to track food, sleep, hydration, medicines, and exercise. Includes follow-up check-boxes and positive weight education.
services.physioTitle: Clinical Care by Dr. Richa Madhu (PT)
services.physioIntro: Antenatal wellness, labour preparation, lactation support, and postnatal rehabilitation.

pillars.title: Antenatal care
pillars.body: Safe exercise, pelvic mobility, and relief from back and rib discomfort.

pillars.title: Preparation for labour
pillars.body: Physio-ball positions, breathing control, and pelvic floor relaxation.

pillars.title: Lactation support
pillars.body: Comfortable latching techniques, posture correction, and breast care.

pillars.title: Postpartum recovery
pillars.body: Assessment, core retraining, diastasis recti care, and pelvic floor rehab.

ancItems: Awareness of psychological changes during pregnancy, and an explanation of physiological changes
Lifestyle changes, including nutrition guidelines, and sleep and rest
Sleep position, sitting position, and changes for daily work
Breathing exercises for relaxation, and for intercostal pain and discomfort
services.safetyBody: Physiotherapy electrical modalities are not given in the childbearing period. TENS and therapeutic ultrasound are not used during antenatal care.
services.exerciseIntro: These are taught according to the stage of pregnancy and the mother’s own needs.
exerciseItems: Upper- and lower-limb strengthening, with or without resistance, in a low-risk mother
familyItems: Education and awareness for the father and the family
Partner involvement, supportive communication, and massage techniques for labour
Warning signs and red flags that need immediate contact with the consultant
redFlags: Severe abdominal pain or sudden swelling
labourItems: A partner or relative for emotional support and tactile stimulation
Positions in labour on a physio ball
TENS and massage for pain relief in labour
A cooling pad for pain after a vaginal delivery
Breathing, relaxation, and labour positions taught beforehand
services.labourPlansTitle: Two ways labour support is offered
labourPlans: Counselling, which is included in the package
The practitioner’s presence in labour, at an extra charge
services.lactationIntro: Guidance so that breastfeeding after birth can be simpler and more comfortable for mother and baby.
lactationItems: Advice for nipple pain and irritation during breastfeeding
Advice for flat or inverted nipples
Advice on a nipple shield for flat, inverted, or cracked nipples
Advice about massage on the breasts
Teaching the mother about a pump, if needed
services.postIntro: A personal programme to bring the body gradually back toward its previous function. The timing is decided after assessment. It is not the same for every mother.
postItems: Education about the pelvic floor muscles, with the help of a model
Functional activity progression: lifting the baby, sitting, standing, and daily activities
Caesarean incision positioning advice and scar mobilisation
Scar mobilisation, at the right time, for an earlier surgery or another scar
services.timingBody: The start of exercise after birth is not the same for every mother. Whether the birth was a normal delivery or a caesarean section, what happened during the birth, and the medical condition should be assessed by the physiotherapist before the time is decided. A fixed rule of 6 weeks or 10 weeks should not be applied to everyone.
neoItems: Neonatal care guidelines and nutrition guidelines as per Ayurveda
Advice for an abdominal binder, only under a gynaecologist’s guidance
Incision infection management is charged extra, per session
services.emotionBody: The father and the family have an important place in garbha sanskar. Counselling covers emotional support for the mother, help with daily tasks, preparation for birth, and taking part in the baby’s care. It also covers emotional changes after birth, including possible signs of postpartum depression, and encourages seeing a mental-health specialist when needed.
modalities: TENS and therapeutic ultrasound for pain management after delivery
Electrical stimulation for pelvic-floor training in incontinence, prolapse, and vaginal laxity after birth
tools: Vonfidans, for pelvic-floor assessment and rehabilitation
500 g to 1 kg dumbbells and resistance bands for strengthening in antenatal and postnatal care
rooms: Air conditioning, and a speaker for garbha sangeet
Yellow light for meditation and dhyan
Postpartum weight-reduction equipment only at Sanidhi Physiotherapy Clinic
